name.zh: 南京审计大学外国留学生奖学金
name.ru: Стипендия Нанкинского университета аудита для иностранных студентов

scholarshipCandidates.scope: International undergraduate, postgraduate and language students studying at NAU for at least one academic year, including eligible new applicants.

tiers: Full scholarship: CNY 30,000 per year for postgraduates
Full scholarship: CNY 17,000 per year for undergraduates
Partial scholarship: CNY 10,000 per year for postgraduates
Partial scholarship: CNY 8,000 per year for undergraduates
Partial scholarship: CNY 5,000 per year for language students
HSK Excellence Scholarship: CNY 500 / 600 / 700 for HSK 4 / 5 / 6

evidence.sourceTitle: NAU Regulations on International Student Scholarship

summary.en: NAU's official regulations establish annual full, partial, individual and HSK scholarships for international degree and language students, with exact full and partial award amounts. The regulations state a recurring September–October application period, but no future cycle is marked open without a dated annual notice.
summary.zh: 南京审计大学官方制度面向国际学历生和语言生设立全额、部分、单项及HSK奖学金，并公布全额和部分奖学金具体标准。制度写明每年9月至10月申请，但没有当年通知前不标记未来周期开放。
summary.ru: Официальное положение NAU учреждает ежегодные полные, частичные, индивидуальные и HSK-стипендии для иностранных студентов и указывает точные суммы. Повторяющийся период сентябрь–октябрь не помечается открытым без датированного ежегодного объявления.

summary.ru: Официальное объявление международного колледжа Университета Яньтая предусматривает две ступени поддержки иностранных магистрантов и докторантов: год обучения и проживания либо год обучения. Цикл не помечен открытым без независимо подтвержденного срока.

exclusions.reason: No second concrete international-student program or school-level scholarship with sufficient official evidence was located; the existing Tibetan-language non-degree record remains the only publishable identity.

Domestic undergraduate catalogs and commercial overseas pathway programs were excluded. Only disciplines explicitly confirmed by the foreign-national doctoral guide were retained; no verified school-level international scholarship was found.

The 2026 'international undergraduate' 2+2 pathway was excluded because it is an overseas-credit pathway rather than a regular degree awarded by the Academy. No verified school-level international scholarship was found.

Generic international-undergraduate placeholders sourced only to the university homepage were excluded. The already-published Master of Auditing remains the only concrete program with sufficient evidence in this pass.

notes: ZUFE gains three concrete international-catalog programs; ZAFU gains three English-taught 2026 bachelor programs with exact duration and tuition.
YUFE gains two concrete degree programs with exact duration and tuition; CAFA gains two foreign-national doctoral disciplines; CAD gains one foreign-graduate discipline.
Four official international-student scholarship identities are added for NAU, Yantai University, YUFE and ZAFU.
No guessed value or open cycle is included. Tibet University remains a documented evidence gap rather than receiving a synthetic record.
